related.title: HDF5 SWMR：可見長度與應用發布邊界
related.titleEn: HDF5 SWMR: visible extent and application publication boundaries
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付三種範圍、聯集演算、重疊反例與重建/驗證兩條進度線，註明適用的重建工作流；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver all three range types, union calculations, overlap cases and separate reconstruction and verification progress lines. Identify the workflow being modeled rather than generalizing one sequence to every pool layout. Have a peer reproduce both configurations from the artifacts, retaining failed cases and limitations. Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system.
related.difference: 建立 data_flush、reader_refresh、commit_marker 事件表；每筆記單調序號與觀察時間，消費者僅讀 [0,safe_count)。
related.differenceEn: Build data-flush, reader-refresh and commit-marker events with monotonic sequence numbers and observation times. The consumer reads only [0,safe_count), retaining the three observed bounds separately.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 驗證覆蓋率是已完成 checksum 檢查的獨特位元組除本次目標範圍；重複掃描同一範圍不能增加覆蓋；目標 100 GiB 且已全部重建；名義 checksum 覆蓋 40 GiB，變更 100 GiB；不存在未解決的 checksum 錯誤；名義式 40/100*100 = 40 % verified coverage；變更式 100/100*100 = 100 % verified coverage。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。

本課保守消費上限為已 flush 資料數、讀者可見 extent 與應用 committed_count 的最小值；這不是 HDF5 內建跨物件交易；資料已 flush 52 筆、讀者 extent 為 49；committed_count 名義 48、變更 50，其他狀態固定；名義式 min(min(52,49),48) = 48 records safe to consume；變更式 min(min(52,49),50) = 49 records safe to consume。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Verification coverage is unique target bytes whose checksum checks completed divided by the target range. Repeated scans of the same range do not increase coverage, even if total I/O counters grow. The target is 100 GiB and reconstruction is complete in both cases. Checksum coverage changes from 40 to 100 GiB, with no unresolved checksum failures in the covered portions. Nominal 40/100*100 = 40 % verified coverage; changed 100/100*100 = 100 % verified coverage. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

The teaching consumer limit is the minimum of flushed data count, reader-visible extent and application committed_count. This explicit application protocol is not an HDF5 built-in multi-object transaction guarantee. Data are flushed through 52 records and the reader-visible extent is 49. Application committed_count changes from 48 to 50 while the other observations remain fixed. Nominal min(min(52,49),48) = 48 records safe to consume; changed min(min(52,49),50) = 49 records safe to consume. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 超算餘熱：熱量與可用功的 Carnot 上界
related.titleEn: Supercomputer waste heat: thermal quantity and the Carnot work bound
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付三種範圍、聯集演算、重疊反例與重建/驗證兩條進度線，註明適用的重建工作流；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver all three range types, union calculations, overlap cases and separate reconstruction and verification progress lines. Identify the workflow being modeled rather than generalizing one sequence to every pool layout. Have a peer reproduce both configurations from the artifacts, retaining failed cases and limitations. Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system.
related.difference: 建立 Qhot、Thot_K、Tcold_K 與邊界描述；拒絕攝氏直接取比、熱端不高於冷端等不適用輸入。
related.differenceEn: Record heat input, hot and cold absolute temperatures and boundary definitions. Reject Celsius ratios and a hot reservoir no warmer than the cold one as invalid for the intended positive-work comparison.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 驗證覆蓋率是已完成 checksum 檢查的獨特位元組除本次目標範圍；重複掃描同一範圍不能增加覆蓋；目標 100 GiB 且已全部重建；名義 checksum 覆蓋 40 GiB，變更 100 GiB；不存在未解決的 checksum 錯誤；名義式 40/100*100 = 40 % verified coverage；變更式 100/100*100 = 100 % verified coverage。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。

固定兩熱庫的理想功率上界為 Qhot*(1-Tcold/Thot)，溫度必須為 K；有限流體冷卻過程不等同固定熱庫；熱輸入 100 kW、冷庫 293 K；熱庫由 313 增為 323 K。此例不含泵耗與實際轉換設備；名義式 100*(1-293/313) = 6.38977635783 kW ideal work bound；變更式 100*(1-293/323) = 9.28792569659 kW ideal work bound。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Verification coverage is unique target bytes whose checksum checks completed divided by the target range. Repeated scans of the same range do not increase coverage, even if total I/O counters grow. The target is 100 GiB and reconstruction is complete in both cases. Checksum coverage changes from 40 to 100 GiB, with no unresolved checksum failures in the covered portions. Nominal 40/100*100 = 40 % verified coverage; changed 100/100*100 = 100 % verified coverage. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

Between fixed-temperature reservoirs, ideal work output is bounded by Qhot*(1-Tcold/Thot), with temperatures in kelvin. A finite stream cooling over a range is not identical to this reservoir model. Supply 100 kW of heat to a hypothetical engine with a 293 K cold reservoir. Hot-reservoir temperature changes from 313 to 323 K, excluding pumps and any actual conversion equipment. Nominal 100*(1-293/313) = 6.38977635783 kW ideal work bound; changed 100*(1-293/323) = 9.28792569659 kW ideal work bound. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
